Standard operating procedure · Accounts

Creating a Facebook Profile + Page

How we make her Facebook profile, then her Facebook page. Watch the video first, then follow this step by step, every time.

Version v0.1Updated 10 Nov 2026Owner KTool Facebook app · Samsung
Download PDF

01Profile and page

Before anything else. K explains Facebook profiles and pages. Watch it first.

Video not playing? Open it here: https://www.loom.com/share/c8c106abaf034c90bae04e7cd62922eb

Facebook is two things: her profile and her page. They are different.

The profile · the land

Every page needs a profile to own it. Fans never see it. It stays plain: her name, no profile picture needed, a few niche pages followed. It just has to exist and look like a person.

The page · the house

What fans see and follow. Built properly from day one: profile picture, a niche banner, a bio, category, posts. This is where the work goes.

The profile is the land. The page is the house built on it.

⚠ The rules that get accounts banned

NEVER CONNECT THE PHONE TO WI-FI. HOTSPOT ONLY.

NEVER DOWNLOAD A PICTURE FROM GOOGLE DRIVE ONTO THE PHONE. ALWAYS OPEN IT AND TAKE A SCREENSHOT.

The apps can see where a picture came from and how the phone connects. Break one of these and the account gets banned.

02Watch first

How to create a Facebook account. Watch it once for the flow.

Video not playing? Open it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EYgKPSC32Po

03Before you start

  • Her Instagram is made (SOP: Creating an Instagram).
  • The phone is on a hotspot.
  • Her Gmail, password and birthday from the company login sheet. Facebook uses the same.
  • For the page: her profile picture and a niche banner, ready in Google Drive (SOP: Creating Pictures).

04Step by step: the profile

1

Join Facebook

Open Facebook. Press Create new account, then Get started.

Right here, Facebook usually shows her Instagram and offers to use it: "Continue as …", "Use your Instagram account" or "Add to Accounts Center". Press the other option: Create new account / Continue without Instagram / Not now.

Anywhere Facebook asks to use, continue with or connect her Instagram or a Meta account: NEVER. Never link Meta accounts.

Why: connected accounts fall together. If one gets banned, they all get banned.

a screenshot of this screen, to confirm the exact words
2

Her full name

First name and surname: her full name, as in her model deck.

3

Birthday: the same as the Gmail

The same date as her Gmail (she is 19 or 20).

4

Gender: female

Press Female. Always.

5

Sign up with email

It asks for a mobile number. Never. Press Sign up with email address.

Why: a number ties the account to a real SIM and to every other account on it.

6

Her Gmail

The same Gmail as her Instagram.

7

Password: the same as the Gmail

The same password as her Gmail and Instagram.

8

Save login info

Press Save.

9

Agree

Press I agree.

10

No, create new account

"Do you already have a Facebook account?" Press No, create new account.

11

The code

Open the Gmail app, copy the code Facebook sent, put it in.

12

Profile picture: skip

The profile doesn't need one. Press Skip.

13

Contacts: never

Turn on contact uploading? Never. Press Not now or Skip.

Why: contacts link the account to real people and to the other phones.

14

Meta account: always No

It can pop up again later: connect accounts, Accounts Center, log in with Instagram. Always No. Every time.

Why: connected accounts fall together. If one gets banned, they all get banned.

15

Notifications: on

Allow notifications.

16

10 minutes of warm up

Follow a few pages related to her niche. Scroll a little, like a person would. About 10 minutes. That's all the profile needs.

05Step by step: the page

How to create a Facebook page. Watch it once for the flow.

Video not playing? Open it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FVw6pNknY_s

An accurate video. He leaves out the profile picture and banner: we do those at the end (steps 11 and 12).

1

Menu → Pages

On her profile, open the Menu (☰), press See more, then Pages.

2

Create → Professional

Press Create. Which option is best for you? Professional. Next.

3

Create a new Page

Press Create a new Page. Next.

4

Page name

Her Instagram username, written out: capital letters and spaces are fine here.

padawangrace → Padawan Grace · kiraofvulcan → Kira Of Vulcan · sophieofmordor → Sophie Of Mordor

5

Category: Digital creator, Personal blog

Search and add both: Digital creator and Personal blog. Then Create Page.

The video picks other categories. Ours are always these two.

6

Bio

Like her Instagram bio, a little more descriptive. page bio examples

7

Contact, location, hours: leave empty

Leave them empty. Press Next.

8

Customize: skip for now

Profile picture and cover photo: skip for now. They come at the end (steps 11 and 12).

9

Invite friends: skip

Don't invite anyone. Press Next.

10

Notifications: on

Keep both notifications on. Press Done.

11

Profile picture

On the page: press the camera on the profile picture and add hers. Open it in Google Drive and take a screenshot.

Examples · tap to open

NEVER download it from Google Drive. Always the screenshot.

12

Banner

Press Add cover photo: always something from her niche. Her world, no text, no people's faces up close. Find them on Pinterest: search her niche plus banner or wallpaper (e.g. lord of the rings banner).

Screenshot it from Drive. Never download.

13

Hide AI comments

Do this the moment the account exists. Before anything gets posted.

Fans who find her have to feel she is real. One "this is AI" comment under a post and everyone who reads it starts to wonder. So the account hides those comments before anyone sees them.

Where: As the page: Settings → Privacy → Page and tagging → hide comments containing certain words. (Or Professional dashboard → Moderation Assist.)

Paste this list in, then turn Hide comments ON:

ai, Ai, aI, AI, a.i, A.i, a.I, A.I, a.i., A.I., ia, i.a, slop, sloop, fake, faked, deepfake, deep fake, scam, bot, gpt, chatgpt, dalle, midjourney, ai slop, not real, fake account, fake profile
Screenshot · fbp-hw · hidden words on the page
14

Upload at highest quality: ON

Turn this on now, before the first post. It’s off by default.

Where: Menu (☰) → Settings & privacy → Settings → Media → upload photos and videos in HD: on. check the exact names on the phone

Why: with it off, Facebook squashes every picture and video when it uploads. Her posts come out blurry next to the real girls’ posts. This is why quality dropped before.

15

Warm it up

As the page: follow a few pages like ours and a few pages from her niche. Scroll a little, like a real person. A few minutes.

Why: a page that follows nothing looks empty and new. A few follows make it look lived in.

16

Into the login sheet

Page name next to her logins in the sheet.

06Done means

  • A profile and a page, made with her Gmail, same password, same birthday.
  • No phone number. No contacts. No Meta account connection.
  • The profile: her name, 10 minutes of warm up, niche pages followed.
  • The page: profile picture and niche banner (screenshots, never downloads), bio, Digital creator + Personal blog.
  • The page follows a few pages like ours and from her niche.
  • Hidden words in on the page, Hide comments on.
  • Upload in HD on.
  • Notifications on. Page name in the company login sheet.

07Common mistakes

  • Pressing Yes to the Meta account. One ban, all banned.
  • A phone number instead of the email.
  • No banner on the page. An empty cover looks fake.
  • Downloading the picture from Drive instead of a screenshot.
